_note: The arena's modes (docs/RESEARCH_PHASE_11.md sections 13 and 14). Team deathmatch: Apex is 6v6, first to 40, 10 minutes; the arena holds teams of up to 4, so ours is first to 30 (ours). Gun Run, Crown and Search were the legacy game's and went with it (the owner, 2026-10-04: "remove all legacy stuff").
_ffa: Free-for-all (ours; Apex has none, and the arena modes' shared rules give it for free): everyone for themselves in the arena, respawns, first to 20 kills or the most at 10 minutes, the fewest deaths on a tie, bots by the host's setting. A respawn picks the spot farthest from any enemy, as the other modes' do.
_control: Control (docs/RESEARCH_PHASE_12.md section 3), scaled to the arena: Apex plays 9 v 9 over three zones, 1 point a second per zone held, first to 1,000 or 30 minutes, a 150-point bonus zone, spawns on zones linked to your base, and a lockout when one team holds all three. Ours: 5 v 5, first to 500 or 10 minutes. The capture speed by the number on a zone is Apex's (1, 1.5, 2, 2.25, 2.5, 2.75, 3); the base capture time (8 s from neutral with one player, twice that to take an enemy's), the bonus timings, the lockout's 30 s and the 5 s respawn are ours (Apex's are unpublished, and it respawns in waves of up to 10 s). These zones are in arena coordinates, the rules' own checks' (verify.ts); a match takes its map's (src/game/arenas).

control._zoneHeight: Metres over the street that still count as on a zone (modematch.ts onZones, Milestone 942): over a double jump, and under the Sky Ring's deck at 3.5 m, which covers 43 to 44% of each of THE CENTRE's zones and held them from above.

_bots: bots added to a mode with no teams (free-for-all) by the host's setting; team deathmatch and Control fill both teams to teamSize. The cap is what the frame rate will carry rather than what the arena was drawn for: the owner asked to be able to put thirty and more in a match, to stress the game and to have something always shooting. Past the spawns a map has, they are stepped out around them (stepOut).
_spawnFacing: Which way you face when an arena match puts you down. A spawn faces the middle, and the new arenas put a pillar or a container on that line on purpose, to break the shot from one spawn to the other; so a spawn faced the box a metre away. Now the facing turns, in steps of `step` degrees either side up to `sweep`, to the nearest heading with at least `clear` metres of open view, and keeps the middle when it already has that. Ours.
_stepOut: More bodies than a list of starts has points (a free-for-all's thirty bots, a team's fifth on an end of four): each lap round the list takes the next clear place on rings of these radii, in metres, round the point it shares, eight to a ring. Clear is `edge` metres inside the arena's walls and its circle, and no wall within `pad` of the body between `knee` and `head` metres over the floor the point stands on. A fixed 2.6 m grid step put a team's fifth in a wall on THE CENTRE and out past NEON HALL's walls (Milestone 738). Ours.
